description: WingHarness plugin: cursor-byok routes Cursor's requests to your own model channels, with a built-in web console.
notes: Settings and the SQLite database live in $persist_dir and survive scoop update.
Start it from WingHarness (Settings > Plugins) or run start.cmd in the install folder.
The first start writes .env with a random CURSOR_EXTERNAL_API_KEY.
